meta.title: About Kamil Pinas - Frontend Developer & UI Engineer
meta.description: Learn more about Kamil Pinas, a passionate Frontend Developer and UI Engineer, his philosophy, experience, and what he does outside of coding.

aboutPage.title: About - {{name}}
aboutPage.jobSubtitle: I build accessible, performant, and delightful web experiences.

philosophy.title: My Philosophy
philosophy.content: In my {{experienceYears}} years of experience, I've come to believe that the best web interfaces are born from a deep understanding of both the user and the technology. My goal is to create applications that are not only functional and visually appealing but also accessible to everyone and performant on any device.

experience.title: What I Do
experience.content: I specialize in building complex, interactive, and high-performing user interfaces with a focus on modern web technologies. From designing responsive layouts that work on any device to optimizing application performance, I am committed to creating web experiences that are both user-friendly and technically excellent.

process.title: My Process
process.description: My process begins with a deep dive into the project's goals, where I focus on understanding the user's needs to create intuitive and accessible interfaces. I then translate these insights into functional, high-performance code, ensuring that every detail is polished. I believe in a collaborative and iterative approach, working closely with teams to refine and perfect the final product.

afterHours.title: After Hours
afterHours.content: When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or diving into the world of video games. I am also a huge fan of superheroes, and if you're curious about my taste, you can check out my personal ranking.

meta.title: Contact Kamil Pinas - Frontend Developer for Collaboration
meta.description: Get in touch with Kamil Pinas for frontend development projects, UI engineering, or general inquiries. Available for freelance/contract work.

contactPage.title: Contact - {{name}}
contactPage.header: Make It Clear. Make It Fast. Make It Live.
contactPage.description: Have a project to launch, a UI to polish, or performance issues to fix? I help teams ship clean, accessible, and fast interfaces that users love. I’m available for freelance/contract work and open to full‑time conversations.

typescript.name: TypeScript
typescript.description: Advanced proficiency in leveraging TypeScript's static type system to build scalable, maintainable applications. Expert in defining complex type interfaces, generics, enums, and utility types, with deep understanding of compiler options and configuration through `tsconfig.json`.
highlights: Created robust type definitions for complex data structures and API responses
Implemented advanced type utilities and conditional types for type-safe utilities
Configured strict TypeScript compiler options for maximum type safety

html5.name: HTML5
html5.description: Deep understanding of semantic HTML5 elements, web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1, WAI-ARIA), and modern web standards. Experienced in creating accessible, SEO-friendly markup that works across all modern browsers and devices.
highlights: Implemented complex accessible widgets with proper ARIA attributes
Optimized HTML structure for search engine visibility
Ensured cross-browser compatibility and progressive enhancement

css3.name: CSS3
css3.description: Expertise in modern CSS features including Flexbox, Grid, CSS Variables, and animations. Strong understanding of responsive design principles, CSS architecture (BEM, ITCSS), and performance optimization techniques for styling.
highlights: Built complex responsive layouts using CSS Grid and Flexbox
Implemented theme systems with CSS Custom Properties
Optimized CSS delivery for performance-critical applications

javascript.name: ES6+
javascript.description: Deep knowledge of modern JavaScript features including ES6+ syntax, asynchronous programming (Promises, async/await), functional programming concepts, modules, and the latest language features through TC39 proposals.
highlights: Implemented complex asynchronous workflows with async/await
Leveraged functional programming patterns for data transformation
Optimized JavaScript performance through modern patterns and techniques

performance-optimization.name: Performance Optimization
performance-optimization.description: Expertise in optimizing web application performance through code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, and efficient data fetching strategies. Experience with Core Web Vitals and performance monitoring tools.
highlights: Improved Lighthouse scores by 40+ points
Reduced bundle size through code splitting and tree shaking
Implemented performance budgets and monitoring

web-security.name: Web Security
web-security.description: Strong understanding of web security principles including Content Security Policy (CSP), Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) prevention, Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection, and secure authentication practices.
highlights: Implemented secure authentication flows with JWT
Configured CSP headers for enhanced security
Conducted security audits and vulnerability assessments

pwa.name: PWA
pwa.description: Experience building Progressive Web Applications with service workers, offline capabilities, push notifications, and installable features. Knowledge of PWA best practices and performance optimization.
highlights: Implemented offline-first applications with service workers
Added push notification capabilities
Optimized PWA for Core Web Vitals

react.name: React & Hooks
react.description: Mastery of React's component model, including functional components, hooks, and advanced patterns for state and effect management. Expert in performance optimization, accessibility, and building reusable component libraries.
highlights: Architected large-scale React applications with optimized rendering
Created custom hooks for complex business logic reuse
Implemented advanced patterns like compound components and render props

lodash.name: Lodash
lodash.description: Frequent use of utility libraries like Lodash for efficient and readable data manipulation, including array transformations, object merging, throttling, and debouncing functions.
highlights: Implemented performance improvements using Lodash's throttle/debounce functions
Simplified complex array operations
Ensured code readability through standard utility methods

redux-toolkit.name: Redux Toolkit
redux-toolkit.description: Experience with designing and implementing complex application state using Redux Toolkit (RTK) for efficient, standardized, and scalable state management. Knowledge of RTK Query for data fetching and caching.
highlights: Implemented normalized state structures for complex data
Integrated Redux middleware for side effects (redux-saga, redux-observable)
Optimized Redux performance with selectors and memoization

react-context.name: React Context API
react-context.description: Effective utilization of the Context API for dependency injection and managing global state without prop drilling. Experience with performance optimization techniques for context consumers.
highlights: Created theme and authentication providers using Context API
Optimized context updates to prevent unnecessary re-renders
Combined multiple contexts for complex state management

axios.name: Axios
axios.description: Expertise in configuring and utilizing the Axios HTTP client for structured data requests, error handling, and interceptors. Experience with request/response transformation and cancellation.
highlights: Implemented authentication interceptors for JWT tokens
Created custom API clients with retry logic and error handling
Optimized request performance with request cancellation

tailwind-css.name: Tailwind CSS
tailwind-css.description: Expertise in using Tailwind CSS utility-first framework to rapidly build custom user interfaces. Experience with JIT mode, custom configurations, and integrating with component libraries.
highlights: Implemented responsive designs with Tailwind's utility classes
Created custom plugins and configurations
Optimized production builds with PurgeCSS

react-router.name: React Router
react-router.description: Implementing dynamic client-side routing using React Router v6+ to manage views, URL parameters, and nested routes. Experience with data loading and submission APIs.
highlights: Implemented complex nested routing structures
Created protected routes with authentication
Optimized route-based code splitting

material-ui.name: MUI
material-ui.description: Proficiency in using and customizing the Material UI component system, including theming, styled components API, and creating custom components that integrate with the design system.
highlights: Customized MUI theme with design tokens
Created reusable component compositions
Optimized MUI performance with dynamic imports

ui-library-maintenance.name: Design System Maintenance
ui-library-maintenance.description: Proven ability to build, document (e.g., Storybook), and maintain a centralized, reusable internal UI component library. Ensures consistency and version control for design assets across multiple projects.
highlights: Created comprehensive documentation with Storybook
Implemented automated visual regression testing
Managed semantic versioning and changelog generation

styled-components.name: Styled Components
styled-components.description: Extensive experience with CSS-in-JS solutions, primarily Styled Components, for creating dynamic, scoped styles tied directly to React components. Strong command over theming and prop-based styling.
highlights: Built robust theming solutions supporting dark/light modes
Utilized transient props for style variations
Maintained type safety within style definitions

ag-grid.name: Ag-Grid
ag-grid.description: Experience implementing and configuring advanced, highly performant data grids with Ag-Grid. Includes features like row virtualization, server-side operations, custom cell renderers, and Excel-like filtering.
highlights: Implemented complex data grids with custom cell editors
Optimized performance for large datasets with virtualization
Created custom plugins and extensions for Ag-Grid

accessibility.name: a11y
accessibility.description: Strong commitment to building accessible web applications that follow WCAG 2.1 guidelines. Experience with ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, and accessibility auditing.
highlights: Conducted accessibility audits and implemented fixes
Created accessible custom components with proper keyboard support
Trained teams on accessibility best practices

git.name: Git
git.description: Advanced knowledge of Git for collaborative development, including branching strategies (Git Flow, GitHub Flow), interactive rebasing, cherry-picking, and resolving complex merge conflicts.
highlights: Implemented Git hooks for code quality checks
Managed large codebases with multiple contributors
Created custom Git aliases and scripts

chrome-devtools.name: Chrome DevTools
chrome-devtools.description: Expert use of the Chrome Developer Tools for performance profiling, debugging JavaScript code, inspecting network traffic, memory analysis, and source mapping. Experience with advanced features like Performance and Memory panels.
highlights: Identified and fixed memory leaks in complex applications
Optimized rendering performance using Performance panel
Debugged complex race conditions with async stack traces

react-i18next.name: i18next
react-i18next.description: Experience implementing internationalization (i18n) and localization (l10n) workflows using libraries like i18next, managing translation files, and handling language switching seamlessly.
highlights: Integrated i18n into Next.js SSR workflows
Managed pluralization and context-aware translations
Configured language detection and fallback

jest.name: Jest & RTL
jest.description: Experience with comprehensive testing strategies including unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress. Focus on testing implementation details and user behavior.
highlights: Achieved high test coverage for critical application paths
Created maintainable test suites with best practices
Implemented visual regression testing

webpack.name: Webpack
webpack.description: Deep understanding of Webpack configuration, optimization techniques, and plugin development. Experience with code splitting, lazy loading, and performance optimization.
highlights: Optimized build performance with caching and parallelization
Implemented custom Webpack plugins and loaders
Configured complex build pipelines for multiple environments

vite.name: Vite
vite.description: Familiarity with Vite as a next-generation frontend build tool, leveraging native ES modules and esbuild for fast development server and optimized production builds.
highlights: Migrated projects from Webpack to Vite for improved DX
Configured Vite plugins for specific project needs
Optimized Vite configuration for production builds

electron.name: Electron
electron.description: Experience developing, bundling, and deploying cross-platform desktop applications utilizing web technologies via the Electron framework. Knowledge of native APIs and performance optimization.
highlights: Built and deployed production Electron applications
Implemented native features and integrations
Optimized Electron app performance and resource usage

ci-cd.name: CI/CD
ci-cd.description: Experience setting up and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Docker. Knowledge of automated testing and deployment strategies.
highlights: Created automated deployment pipelines
Implemented blue-green deployment strategies
Configured automated testing in CI/CD

monorepo.name: Monorepo Management
monorepo.description: Experience managing monorepos with tools like Nx, Lerna, or Turborepo. Knowledge of workspace management, dependency management, and optimized build processes in monorepo environments.
highlights: Migrated multiple repositories to a monorepo structure
Optimized build times with task caching and parallelization
Managed shared dependencies and versioning

docker.name: Docker
docker.description: Experience using Docker to create consistent, reproducible development and production environments. Skilled in writing Dockerfiles, utilizing Docker Compose, and deploying containerized applications.
highlights: Containerized frontend builds for reproducible CI/CD
Set up multi-service local development environments with Docker Compose
Configured Nginx serving for optimized static asset delivery

dayjs.name: Day.js
dayjs.description: Ultra-lightweight (2kB) date library with a Moment.js-like API. Used for parsing, validating, manipulating, and formatting dates with minimal bundle impact. Extensible via plugins like timezone, localizedFormat, and customParseFormat.
highlights: Replaced Moment.js in production apps to reduce bundle size by ~60KB
Used plugin system for timezone handling without bloat
Formatted dates consistently across UIs with locale support

date-fns.name: date-fns
date-fns.description: Modern, functional date utility library with excellent TypeScript support. Each function is a standalone, tree-shakable module — ideal for performance-critical applications. Strong focus on immutability and purity.
highlights: Imported only needed functions to minimize bundle size
Leveraged FP submodule for curried, composable date operations
Handled complex relative date calculations (e.g., '3 days ago') with formatDistance

moment-js.name: Moment.js (Legacy)
moment-js.description: Extensive experience with Moment.js in legacy projects — now actively migrating away due to its large size, mutable API, and official deprecation. Understand trade-offs and migration paths to Day.js or date-fns.
highlights: Led migration of 3+ projects from Moment.js to Day.js/date-fns
Created codemods and utility wrappers to ease transition
Documented anti-patterns and performance bottlenecks caused by Moment

immer.name: Immer
immer.description: Skilled in simplifying immutable state updates, especially within Redux reducers or Context, using Immer to write intuitive, mutable-style code that is safely converted to immutable updates.
highlights: Simplified deeply nested state updates
Reduced boilerplate in Redux reducers
Ensured state integrity with clear update logic

zod.name: Zod
zod.description: Proficient in using Zod for runtime validation that derives TypeScript types automatically. Excellent for validating API inputs, environment variables, and form schemas.
highlights: Ensured strict type safety for all incoming data
Validated complex configuration objects at startup
Created complex nested validation schemas

recharts.name: Recharts
recharts.description: Experience building rich, interactive data visualizations using Recharts. Capable of creating custom axes, tooltips, and integrating charts into dashboard environments.
highlights: Developed custom, responsive charting components
Integrated complex data pipelines into visual displays
Ensured charts were accessible and themeable

react-hook-form.name: React Hook Form
react-hook-form.description: Skilled in using React Hook Form for high-performance, controlled/uncontrolled form management, leveraging native browser performance features and minimizing unnecessary re-renders.
highlights: Achieved near-zero re-renders during form input
Implemented dynamic field arrays with useFieldArray
Integrated with Zod for schema-based validation

redux-saga.name: Redux Saga
redux-saga.description: Proficiency in managing complex asynchronous side effects within Redux applications using Redux Saga for predictable state flows.
highlights: Managed complex race conditions with Saga cancellation
Created reusable saga watchers and workers
Implemented robust error handling in middleware

d3.name: D3.js
d3.description: Fundamental understanding of D3.js for direct, granular control over data-driven DOM manipulation and custom visualizations, often used as a backbone for higher-level charting libraries.
highlights: Created unique, highly customized SVG charts
Implemented data binding and transitions

emotion.name: @emotion
emotion.description: Experience with Emotion for high-performance CSS-in-JS styling, utilizing its capabilities for dynamic theming, critical CSS extraction, and composition via the `css` prop.
highlights: Optimized runtime performance with Emotion's low overhead
Managed complex theme objects
Created component libraries using styled and css utilities

story-book.name: Storybook
story-book.description: Extensive experience using Storybook to develop, document, and test UI components in isolation. Proficient with ArgsTable, controls, and creating effective component documentation.
highlights: Created component catalogs for multiple projects
Integrated component testing addons
Used Docs page for comprehensive component usage guides
